In this episode of Tooling Up, host Toni Neary is joined by Dan Hacker, Director of Channel Development, and Chris Wagner, Inside Channel Account Manager for Justrite and Eagle Safety Cabinets, to discuss how manufacturers can take a more proactive approach to facility safety and hazardous material storage.


Together, they explore how changing workplace hazards, evolving regulations, and emerging risks like lithium-ion batteries are reshaping safety cabinet needs. The conversation covers choosing the right cabinet for an application, manual versus self-closing models, outdoor hazardous material storage, and Justrite solutions including ChargeGuard and Utili-Guard. Dan also explains how Justrite Safety Group's STUD-E program helps manufacturers identify potential safety and compliance gaps and find solutions before an incident occurs **.**
